environment: ### Org-wide
**Organization**: None configured
**Cloud provider(s)**: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), managed with gcloud and Terraform
**Repository visibility**: work repos are private; `~/dotfiles` is public, so never commit work details, generated files or credentials there
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Secrets management**: None configured — repos use local, gitignored `.env` files
**Default / protected branches**: main is the default branch; treat it as protected
**CI/CD deploy targets**: None configured
**Network posture**: None configured
**Host containment**: None configured — assume Claude Code runs on an ordinary developer machine with open internet
**Source control**: the current repo and its origin remote only
**Trusted internal domains**: None configured
**Trusted cloud buckets**: None configured
**Key internal services**: None configured
**Internal package registry**: None configured

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: `.env` and `.env.*` files (except `.env.example`), Terraform state (`*.tfstate`, `.terraform/`), credentials and keys; share only with audiences cleared at the [named+specifics] bar
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured
**Sensitive remote targets**: any project, namespace, host, bucket or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: None configured — fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
### User-specific
**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development (TypeScript, Python, Go, Terraform on GCP) and maintaining these dotfiles
**Trusted repos**: git repos under `~/code`, `~/personal` and `~/dotfiles`, each with its own origin remote
**Org-specific CLIs**: None configured
**Branch naming**: branches start with `asamgx/`, never `gandrewsameh/` or other prefixes
